Job Description: 
 Respiratory Protection Regulatory Engagement Specialist 
 Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World 
 Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.
 This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career. 
 The Impact You’ll Make in this Role 
 As a Respiratory Protection Regulatory Engagement Specialist in 3M’s Personal Safety Division (PSD), you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world.
 You will collaborate with multidisciplinary colleagues around the world to advance respiratory protection standards, regulations, and occupational health and safety (OHS) practices across global markets. You will represent 3M in high-impact regulatory and standards-development activities, engaging with OHS professionals, industry stakeholders, and regulators as a technical thought leader. In this role, you will shape science-based approaches and provide technical leadership.
 Here, you will make an impact by:
 Facilitating the development of science-based performance and selection and use standards for respiratory protection equipment and occupational health and safety, while tracking progress and key milestones.
 Identifying opportunities to advance respirator related health and safety policies and regulations and developing strategies to implement science-based approaches.
 Helping to coach, mentor, develop, and coordinate PSD’s global team of application engineers and regulatory specialists engaged in respiratory protection standards development activities.
 Collaborating with professional associations, educational organizations, public health organizations, and relevant government entities.
 Representing 3M in standards development organizations and related technical committees.
 Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align on PSD’s highest-priority respirator related standards and regulations that support business growth.
 Leading respirator related research to support new technologies and existing products.
 Communicating emerging respiratory protection standards, regulatory, and policy developments to relevant stakeholders and translating their potential implications into actionable business guidance.
 Your Skills and Expertise 
 To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:  
 Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start)
 Five (5) years of experience with respiratory protection-related occupational health and safety regulations and performance standards in a private, public, government or military environment.
 Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
 Master’s degree in occupational health and safety, industrial hygiene, public policy, regulatory affairs, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
 Experience representing an organization with regulatory agencies, standards-development organizations, industry associations, policymakers, or government affairs stakeholders.
 Experience conducting or leading applied research in respiratory protection or personal protective equipment.
 Ability to translate complex technical, regulatory, or policy information into clear guidance for diverse audiences.
 Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder-management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
 Ability to work effectively across cultures, geographies, and global teams.
 Work location: 
 This role follows an on-site working model, requiring the employee to work at least four days a week at the 3M Center in Maplewood, MN or London, Ontario.
 Travel: May include up to 25% domestic and international 
 Relocation Assistance: Is not authorized 
 Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status). 
 Supporting Your Well-being 
 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.
 Chat with Max 
 For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Role Overview:

Evaluation is critical to making progress in scaling intelligence. As models continue to become superhuman in many real-world use cases, we must continue to develop new evaluation techniques that accurately reflect what models are already capable of, as well as set the agenda for what future models should be capable of. In this role, you are responsible for creating these next-generation evaluation methods and infrastructure to measure LLM progress.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Create ambitious new evaluation benchmarks that push the limits of what our models can accomplish.

 - Work on highly cross-functional teams to translate model feedback into trustworthy, repeatable evaluations.

 - Conduct research to advance the state-of-the-art in LLM evaluation methods, including training LLM judges; refining LLM-based data synthesis pipelines; and improving evaluation efficiency.

 - Build scalable and reusable tools for digging into model performance.



Qualifications:

 - You enjoy rapidly building prototypes that demonstrate the boundaries of what LLMs are capable of, and you have developed resources to measure those capabilities.

 - You have spent dozens of hours reviewing complex data and LLM outputs to ensure high data quality.

 - You are obsessive about rigorously measuring AI capabilities, and also about making sure your measurements actually align with the capabilities you care about.

 - You have strong software engineering skills.



Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

 




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

Shift Collab is one of Canada's largest therapy practices, operating virtually to support Canadians coast to coast. We believe going to therapy should feel empowering, and we are on a mission to make therapy human by providing mental health care that's approachable, meaningful, and designed to make a real impact. Founded in 2016, we're a family-owned business that has grown from a small clinic to over 125 teammates across Canada, and we're only getting started. 
 We Are Hiring a Bilingual Care Coordinator (English/French)! 
 At Shift Collab, we are on a mission to make a positive impact on people's lives by facilitating their journey towards better mental health. Our Care Team plays a central role in how clients experience therapy. Care Coordinators are often the first human connection someone has with our team, helping people navigate the process of starting therapy and ensuring they feel supported from their first conversation through their ongoing care..
 We're growing our Care Team ahead of a new partnership program launching in February 2027, which will extend our client support hours and bring care to even more Canadians. We're looking for someone who understands that great care coordination is both human and operational, helping clients navigate our systems and ensuring each step of the care journey feels simple and accessible. Someone who brings empathy, organization, and clear communication to every interaction. You will work closely with our clinical and operations teams to ensure everything flows smoothly while keeping track of the details that help a fast-growing practice run effectively. This role is essential to supporting our clients, therapists, and the overall care experience we provide.
 This is a bilingual role: you'll support clients in both English and French, so fluency in both languages is required. This is an hourly role of 25 to 35 hours per week. The ideal candidate has consistent weekend availability (Saturday and Sunday) along with midweek evening availability, as our extended hours will run until 8 PM Pacific Time. We welcome applicants from anywhere in Canada, and candidates based in British Columbia or Alberta are especially encouraged to apply. 
 Who you are: 
 You genuinely enjoy helping people and know how to build trust quickly with clients who may feel vulnerable or unsure about starting therapy.
 You are organized and dependable, comfortable managing multiple priorities while ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
 You are a strong communicator who brings both warmth and clarity to conversations with clients, therapists, and referral partners.
 You take pride in a polished, professional client experience, and you understand that every call and message is a reflection of the care we provide.
 You enjoy working as part of a collaborative team and care about contributing to an experience that supports both clients and therapists.

 Demonstrate advanced empathy and clinical insight, effectively handling complex situations to deliver exceptional client care and support
 Engage with potential clients and support them through the intake process while managing expectations with care and clarity

 Manage incoming communications including email, phone calls, and live chat from clients, referral partners, and therapists, in both English and French
 Coordinate and optimize the clinic's and therapists' schedules, monitor the waitlist, and employ advanced scheduling strategies to ensure efficient appointment management
 Ensure all therapy sessions and consultations are scheduled and resolve any scheduling issues promptly, using your experience to anticipate and address potential conflicts
 Monitor and manage client insurance verification and billing communications, ensuring smooth administrative processes that support the clinical team
 Manage video therapy rooms to ensure smooth online sessions and troubleshoot technical issues when needed

 Provide high-level administrative support to therapists, streamlining client care processes and enhancing overall clinic efficiency

 Fluency in English and French, both written and spoken
 A proven track record and passion for high-quality customer service
 Empathetic and understanding approach to client interactions
 5+ years of experience in healthcare, such as medical receptionist, service navigator, intake specialist, or a similar client care role
 Experience with nurturing a lead into a client and retaining existing clients
 Training or experience in healthcare customer service, medical administration, or supporting vulnerable populations
 Experience working in mental health services is considered an asset
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills
 Experience working with therapists or other allied health professionals, with proficiency in technology and software for scheduling, communication, and video conferencing
 Experience with Jane and HubSpot is an asset
 Ability to multitask, manage schedules, and troubleshoot technical issues
 Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team

 The Opportunity: 
 We’re looking to fill an opening for a Privacy Operations Specialist to join our Privacy Operations team.
 Reporting to the Manager, Privacy Operations, the Privacy Operations Specialist is responsible for the first-line privacy controls and day-to-day execution and delivery of Aviso’s Privacy Program. The role serves as a key operational point of contact for privacy-related inquiries, requests, and incidents across the organization.
 The Privacy Operations Specialist manages privacy incidents and breach reporting, data subject access requests (DSARs), privacy inquiries, program administration, and operational reporting. The role conducts Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), supports privacy risk mitigation across all business lines, and leverages AI-enabled tools to automate repetitive operational tasks. Through strong stakeholder engagement and process optimization, the incumbent ensures compliance with privacy legislation, regulatory requirements, and Aviso's privacy framework while fostering a culture of privacy awareness and accountability.

 We Dare –You challenge the status quo with bold ideas and fresh perspectives. You embrace change, seek opportunities to innovate and are comfortable exploring new ways of working

 We Deliver – You take ownership of your work, honour your commitments and focus on delivering meaningful results. You hold yourself accountable and continuously look for ways to improve
 What your day looks like:

 Lead the intake, assessment, investigation, and management of privacy incidents, breaches, complaints, and inquiries, ensuring timely resolution, regulatory reporting (CIRO ComSet), and effective corrective action implementation

 Triage project and PIA intake requests and conduct routine Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs), and privacy reviews for initiatives, vendors, technologies, and business processes, ensuring privacy risks are identified and mitigated early in the lifecycle
 Act as an embedded Privacy SME representative on operational squads, project teams, and business initiatives, providing practical guidance and driving the adoption of Privacy by Design principles throughout planning, development, implementation, and operationalization activities
 Influence stakeholders and challenge business decisions where appropriate to ensure privacy requirements are effectively incorporated into products, services, processes, and operational workflows
 Develop, maintain, and enhance privacy operational processes, procedures, standards, and controls to support a scalable and sustainable privacy program
 Monitor and track remediation activities, corrective action plans, and outstanding privacy risks, working with business owners to ensure timely closure and accountability
 Maintain privacy logs, trackers, and reporting dashboards that provide meaningful insights into program performance, operational effectiveness, and emerging risks
 Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to streamline repetitive operational tasks, and support the implementation and optimization of privacy management technology and workflow solutions to enhance program maturity, efficiency, and oversight

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

Auto Electric Service Ltd. is seeking a Vice President of Product to lead one of the most important functions in our next stage of growth.
 Founded in 1943, AES is a locally owned Saskatchewan wholesale distribution company serving the automotive aftermarket, agriculture, industrial, heavy-duty, PBE, commercial paint, retail, OEM dealer, jobber, and service markets across Southern Saskatchewan. We are investing heavily in our Distribution Centre, inventory capabilities, technology, people, and systems as we build toward our long-term growth strategy. 
 This is not simply a purchasing role.
 The VP of Product will have executive accountability for Product Assortment, Inventory Strategy, Purchasing, Pricing, Category Management, and Product-related Technology and Analytics .
 The Opportunity 
 The VP of Product will answer some of the most important commercial questions in our business:
 What should we sell?
 What should we stock, where, and how much?
 Which suppliers and product lines should we grow?
 How should we price by market, category, and customer?
 Where should we enter new categories?
 How can data and technology improve these decisions?
 The mission is to build a disciplined, accountable, technology-enabled Product function that delivers broad product availability while improving inventory productivity, contribution margin, GMROI, and return on invested capital. 
 Key Outcomes 
 Build a Smarter Inventory Network
 Lead AES’s enterprise-wide inventory strategy across our Distribution Centre and branch network. Improve fill rates and product availability while reducing excess, obsolete, and unproductive inventory.
 Grow and Optimize the Product Assortment
 Identify assortment gaps, rationalize underperforming SKUs, evaluate new categories, and ensure our product mix reflects actual customer and market demand across Automotive, Agriculture, Industrial, Heavy Duty, and PBE. 
 Lead Pricing Strategy
 Drive the continued evolution from traditional cost-plus pricing toward more data-driven, market-aware pricing designed to improve contribution margin while maintaining competitiveness. 
 Elevate Purchasing
 Transform purchasing into a more strategic, analytical function. Strengthen vendor relationships, improve supplier accountability, negotiate stronger commercial programs, and align purchasing decisions with demand, inventory, and financial outcomes. 
 Build a Disciplined New Product Process
 Ensure new product lines and categories are supported by clear business cases, expected ROI, required inventory investment, launch plans, and post-launch accountability.
 Use Data and Technology as a Competitive Advantage
 Work with internal and external technology partners to improve pricing, demand forecasting, product recommendations, customer insights, inventory positioning, and master data. 
 Build the Team and Function
 Develop the structure, people, processes, scorecards, and operating rhythms required to support AES’s growth. Participate as an active member of the Senior Leadership Team and work cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Logistics, Finance, Marketing, and Technology. 
 What You Bring
 We are looking for a commercially minded, analytical leader who understands the connection between product, inventory, pricing, purchasing, data, and customer demand .
 The ideal candidate will bring:
 8+ years of progressive senior leadership experience in product management, category management, purchasing, pricing, commercial analytics, supply chain, or a related function.
 Proven experience managing significant inventory portfolios and improving inventory productivity, profitability, and GMROI.
 Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience in pricing strategy, supplier negotiations, category management, and demand forecasting.
 Experience using ERP, BI, pricing, inventory, analytics, or other business technology platforms to support decision-making.
 Experience developing or improving pricing, forecasting, predictive analytics, or other data-driven business tools.
 Proven ability to lead teams, manage cross-functional initiatives, and turn complex information into clear business decisions.
 Experience in wholesale distribution, automotive aftermarket, agriculture, industrial, heavy-duty, or PBE is highly desirable.
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field; MBA or advanced credentials are an asset.
 What Success Looks Like
 Success means building a disciplined, data-driven Product organization that provides customers with broad, reliable local product availability while managing inventory and working capital effectively.
 Our purchasing becomes more strategic, supplier performance is measurable, pricing decisions are increasingly data-driven, and new product opportunities are supported by strong business cases. Our teams have better tools and information to make decisions and serve customers.
 Ultimately, the Product function becomes a key driver of profitable growth, inventory productivity, and customer value as AES continues to scale. A full job description is available by request for interested candidates.
 Why Work With Us 
 At Auto Electric Service Ltd., we are in an exciting phase of business growth and expansion. This is an opportunity to join a company that is investing in its future and strengthening its presence within Saskatchewan communities.
 We offer a supportive, team-focused environment where employees are empowered to contribute directly to business growth and build meaningful customer relationships.

 • Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses
 • Comprehensive health and dental insurance
 • Life and disability insurance
 • Company pension plan
 • Employee discounts
 • Flexible scheduling for work-life balance
 • Paid time off and holiday pay
 • Training and development opportunities
 Location: Regina, Saskatchewan
 Travel: Limited
 If you are energized by the opportunity to build, lead, and transform a critical function inside a growing Saskatchewan company, we would like to hear from you.

 Chez GSK, nous œuvrons à prévenir et à traiter les maladies grâce à la science, à la technologie et aux talents. 
 Notre réseau de sites de production de médicaments et de vaccins joue un rôle essentiel dans la mise à disposition de produits de haute qualité pour répondre aux besoins des patients partout dans le monde. Nous investissons dans les technologies de pointe et dans l’amélioration continue de nos procédés afin de répondre aux défis liés à la fabrication de produits toujours plus complexes. 
 À propos du poste 
 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Expert(e) Technologie et procédés (SME Technology) pour joindre l’équipe LMSAT à Ste-foy, Québec. 
 Le poste d’Expert Technologie et procédés – LMSAT est un rôle d’expertise technique visant à assurer la maîtrise, l’optimisation et le soutien des technologies, équipements, systèmes et procédés utilisés dans les activités de fabrication. 
 La personne titulaire du poste agit à titre de référence technique pour les activités liées aux procédés, contribue à la résolution de problèmes complexes et soutient les initiatives d’optimisation, de transfert technologique et d’amélioration des procédés, en collaboration avec les équipes de production, d’ingénierie, de qualité et les partenaires concernés. 
 Vos responsabilités 
 Expertise technique 
 Agir comme expert(e) de référence pour les technologies, équipements et systèmes liés aux procédés de fabrication du site. 
 Fournir une expertise technique pour l’exploitation, la validation, le dépannage et l’optimisation de ces systèmes. 
 Apporter un soutien technique aux équipes opérationnelles et aux différentes parties prenantes du site. 
 Optimisation des procédés 
 Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d’optimisation en cohérence avec le Technical Lifecycle Plan (TLCP). 
 Contribuer à l’amélioration de l’efficacité, de la performance, de l’évolutivité et de la sécurité des procédés. 
 Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de faire progresser les initiatives d’amélioration continue. 
 Gestion des changements 
 Fournir une expertise technique dans l’évaluation de l’impact des modifications proposées aux procédés de fabrication. 
 Évaluer les impacts potentiels des changements sur la qualité, la sécurité et la performance des procédés. 
 Investigations et résolution de problèmes 
 Apporter une expertise technique lors des investigations liées aux déviations. 
 Participer aux analyses de causes racines et contribuer à l’identification de solutions robustes et durables. 
 Transfert technologique 
 Soutenir les activités de transfert technologique, notamment lors de l’introduction de nouveaux procédés, équipements ou technologies. 
 Collaborer avec les équipes concernées afin d’assurer une intégration efficace des nouvelles technologies. 
 Développement de l’expertise 
 Se tenir informé(e) des avancées technologiques et des meilleures pratiques de l’industrie. 
 Partager ses connaissances et contribuer au développement des capacités techniques au sein de l’organisation. 
 Agir comme mentor ou personne-ressource auprès des membres de l’équipe lorsque requis. 
 Collaboration et communication 
 Collaborer avec les responsables LMSAT globaux, les SME technologiques d’autres sites et les équipes locales. 
 Participer à des projets et initiatives à l’échelle de GSK. 
 Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie, des opérations, de la qualité et autres fonctions pertinentes. 
 Communiquer efficacement des informations techniques complexes à différents niveaux de l’organisation. 
 Pourquoi vous? 
 Nous recherchons une personne techniquement solide, autonome et proactive, capable d’agir comme référence dans son domaine et d’influencer efficacement différents partenaires dans un environnement matriciel. 
 Qualifications requises 
 Diplôme universitaire dans une discipline scientifique, technique ou d’ingénierie. 
 Minimum de 5 années d’expérience professionnelle pertinente dans un domaine technique lié aux activités de fabrication. 
 Expérience dans un ou plusieurs domaines liés aux procédés de fabrication, notamment la formulation, le remplissage ou d’autres étapes du procédé. 
 Expérience de travail avec des équipes multidisciplinaires. 
 Expérience en gestion des risques et/ou gestion de projets. 
 Connaissance des exigences réglementaires applicables à son domaine d’expertise. 
 Solides compétences en rédaction technique et en communication. 
 Capacité à influencer et à collaborer avec des parties prenantes à différents niveaux de l’organisation et dans différentes fonctions. 
 Expérience dans la conduite ou la direction d’activités d’amélioration dans un environnement matriciel. 
 Excellente capacité à planifier, organiser et gérer plusieurs priorités afin de respecter les échéanciers. 
 Capacité à travailler avec précision dans un environnement dynamique et sous pression. 
 Anglais avancé, à l’oral et à l’écrit. 
 Ce qui constitue un atout 
 Expérience dans un environnement de fabrication pharmaceutique ou biopharmaceutique. 
 Expérience avec les procédés de formulation ou de remplissage. 
 Expérience en transfert technologique. 
 Expérience en amélioration continue et optimisation des procédés. 
 Expérience en investigation et analyse de causes racines. 
 Connaissance des principes de gestion du cycle de vie des technologies et des procédés. 
 Mode de travail 
 Ce poste est offert en mode hybride, conformément à la politique RH interne en matière de télétravail. Vous serez basé(e) à Sainte-Foy, Québec, et devrez assurer une présence régulière sur le site et sur le terrain, notamment pour collaborer avec les équipes de production, soutenir les activités techniques et participer aux essais, validations et autres activités nécessitant une présence en production. 
 À quoi ressemble la réussite dans ce rôle? 
 Dans ce rôle, votre contribution se traduira notamment par : 
 Des solutions techniques robustes et une documentation technique claire, précise et utilisable. 
 Une réduction des problèmes liés aux procédés et une résolution plus rapide des enjeux techniques. 
 Des transferts de produits, de procédés et de technologies réalisés de façon fluide, dans le respect des exigences de qualité et des échéanciers. 
 Une collaboration efficace entre les équipes de production, d’ingénierie, de qualité, LMSAT et les partenaires externes. 
 Une contribution concrète à l’optimisation et à la performance des procédés de fabrication. 
 Ce que nous offrons 
 Vous rejoindrez une équipe qui valorise l’expertise technique, la collaboration et l’amélioration continue. 
 Ce rôle vous permettra de travailler sur des enjeux techniques concrets, de collaborer avec des experts locaux et internationaux et de contribuer à des projets qui ont un impact direct sur nos procédés de fabrication. 
 Vous aurez également l’occasion de développer votre expertise et votre réseau au sein d’une organisation qui place la science, la technologie et l’innovation au cœur de sa mission. 
 Prêt(e) à faire avancer les choses? 
 Nous aimerions en savoir plus sur vous. 
 Soumettez votre CV ainsi qu’une courte présentation expliquant comment votre expérience correspond aux responsabilités de ce poste. 
 Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation raisonnables dans le cadre du processus de recrutement, veuillez nous en informer au moment de votre candidature. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser l’inclusion et à soutenir tous les candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement. 
 Compétences 
CMC Strategy, Data-Driven Decision Making, Data Integrity, Debate Moderation, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Lean Management, Problem Solving, Process Optimization, Project Leadership, Risk Awareness, Scientific Writing, Technology Transfer  
 Pourquoi GSK?
Allier science, technologie et talent pour vaincre ensemble la maladie. 
 GSK est une entreprise biopharmaceutique mondiale dont la mission est de réunir la science, la technologie et le talent pour prendre ensemble de l'avance sur les maladies. Nous visons à avoir un impact positif sur la santé de 2,5 milliards de personnes d'ici la fin de la décennie, en tant qu'entreprise prospère et en croissance où les gens peuvent s'épanouir. Nous prenons de l'avance sur les maladies en les prévenant et en les traitant grâce à l'innovation dans les médicaments spécialisés et les vaccins. Nous nous concentrons sur quatre domaines thérapeutiques : les maladies respiratoires, l'immunologie et l'inflammation; l'oncologie; le VIH; les maladies infectieuses – pour avoir un impact à grande échelle sur la santé.
 Les gens et les patients partout dans le monde comptent sur les médicaments et les vaccins que nous produisons; c'est pourquoi nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où nos employés peuvent s'épanouir et se concentrer sur ce qui compte le plus. Notre culture, qui repose sur l'ambition pour les patients, la responsabilité de la portée et le fait de faire ce qui est juste, constitue la base de la manière dont nous tenons nos engagements ensemble pour les patients, les actionnaires et nos employés.
 GSK est un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances. Cela garantit que tous les candidats qualifiés recevront une considération égale pour l'emploi sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe (y compris la grossesse, l'identité de genre et l'orientation sexuelle), de statut parental, d'origine nationale, d'âge, de handicap, d'informations génétiques (y compris les antécédents médicaux familiaux), de service militaire ou de toute autre base interdite par la loi fédérale, étatique ou locale. GSK s'engage à accueillir les personnes handicapées. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement à n'importe quelle étape du processus de candidature ou si vous souhaitez plus d'informations sur nos politiques d'aménagement, veuillez nous contacter à canada-recruitment@gsk.com . Veuillez ne pas envoyer de CV à cette adresse e-mail et postuler plutôt via le processus de candidature en ligne de cette annonce.
 Avis important destiné aux services/agences de placement 
 GSK n’accepte pas les propositions des services/agences de placement en vue de pourvoir les postes affichés dans le présent site. Ces services/agences doivent s’adresser au service d’approvisionnement/des ressources humaines de GSK pour obtenir une autorisation écrite avant de lui proposer des candidats. Cette autorisation est une condition préalable à toute entente (orale ou écrite) entre le service/l’agence de placement et GSK. Sans cette autorisation écrite, toute mesure de la part du service/de l’agence de placement doit être considérée comme avoir été appliquée sans le consentement ni l’entente contractuelle de GSK. Par conséquent, GSK ne peut pas être tenue responsable des honoraires attribuables à de telles mesures ni à quelque recommandation que ce soit de la part du service/de l’agence de placement en ce qui concerne sa proposition de candidature en vue de pouvoir un poste annoncé dans le présent site.

About Sadie  
Sadie is building voice AI for hotels. Our agent answers guest calls 24/7, shares property information, quotes real-time availability and rates, books and manages reservations, and integrates with major hotel systems. 
 We're looking for a Demand & Content Marketing Lead to build Sadie Concierge's marketing from the ground up. You'll be the hotel division's first marketing hire, reporting to the VP of Sales & Partnerships. You'll own the numbers that turn hotel attention into sales conversations, including MQLs, conversion rates, sequence performance, and pipeline contribution. You'll also write the content that moves those numbers. 
 You'll work daily with Sales, and closely with Product, Customer Success, and our external PPC and SEO partners. The scope runs from HubSpot and outbound sequences to landing pages, case studies, and campaigns. 
 You'll decide which channels get tested, which content gets made, and what gets cut. AI should be part of how you work. Use it to research, draft, analyze, and automate. You're responsible for the quality of the result. 
 What we value  
 Comfort with numbers, and the discipline to check them before acting on them. 
 Writing that's clear, specific, and worth reading. 
 Owning outcomes and finishing work without being chased. 
 Understanding how the business makes money and caring about results. 
 Curiosity, and a willingness to drop an approach that isn't working. 
 The honesty to say when something isn't good enough, including your own work. 
 What you'll do  
 Build and run the demand engine  
 You'll own MQL generation for the hotel division. You'll agree with Sales on what counts as a marketing-qualified lead, set targets, and report against them every week. When the number misses, you'll know why before anyone asks. 
 Most of your week goes into running programs: outbound and nurture sequences in HubSpot, paid campaigns with our PPC partner, organic search with our SEO partner, email, and landing pages. You'll test several channels in parallel, compare cost per MQL and conversion to opportunity, and move effort toward what works. 
 Write the content that converts  
 You'll write landing pages, email sequences, sales collateral, blog posts, customer stories, case studies, and product announcements yourself. Every piece has a job in the funnel, whether that's ranking for a search term, booking a demo, or helping Sales close. You'll measure whether it does that job. 
 You'll interview hotel customers and sit in on sales calls, so the content reflects how owners, GMs, and front-desk leads talk about missed calls, lost bookings, and upsells. When a piece underperforms, you'll rewrite it or retire it. 
 Own HubSpot and marketing operations  
 You'll own HubSpot end to end, including workflows, segmentation, lead scoring, routing to Sales, and reporting. You'll set lead scoring and handoff rules with the VP of Sales & Partnerships, then adjust them as you learn which signals predict a booked demo. 
 You'll build the attribution view that shows which campaigns, channels, and content pieces contribute to pipeline, and keep the data clean enough for that view to be trusted. If a dashboard says something surprising, you'll investigate before you report it. 
 What you'll bring  
 At least 3 years of hands-on experience in B2B demand generation, content marketing, or performance marketing. 
 You've owned an MQL or pipeline target and can walk us through the numbers behind it. 
 A portfolio of content you wrote yourself, such as landing pages, sequences, case studies, or articles, with results you can point to. 
 Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar platform, including workflows, lead scoring, and reporting. 
 You've built and run outbound or nurture sequences yourself. 
 You can build a report, read a funnel, and spot when a number is wrong. 
 Experience running campaigns across at least three channels, such as paid, email, organic, outbound, or events. 
 Experience working with external partners such as PPC or SEO agencies. 
 You use AI tools to move faster in research, writing, analysis, and automation, and you check what they produce. 
 You can work independently, turn a loose objective into a plan, and see it through. 
 Useful experience  
 SEO content strategy 
 Outbound automation and data enrichment tools 
 Marketing attribution models 
 Hospitality technology, hotels, or travel 
 B2B SaaS or AI products 
 Video or design skills for campaign creative 
 Trade show and event marketing 
 Building a marketing function from scratch
 An engineering, data, or other technical background 
 Why you’ll love working at Sadie 
 You’ll join a fast-growing AI company that’s changing how hotels and restaurants operate.
 Your work will directly shape our go-to-market strategy for hotels.
 You’ll have a lot of autonomy and visibility across both the hotel and restaurant verticals.
 There are clear growth paths: Senior Content Manager, Demand Generation Manager, or Marketing Operations.
 You’ll work in a flexible hybrid environment and have the chance to attend major industry events.

 À propos de Sadie
 Sadie développe une IA vocale pour les hôtels. Notre agent répond aux appels des clients 24 h sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, fournit l'information sur l'établissement, communique les disponibilités et les tarifs en temps réel, prend et gère les réservations, et s'intègre aux principaux systèmes hôteliers.
 Nous cherchons une personne responsable du marketing de la demande et du contenu pour bâtir le marketing de Sadie Concierge à partir de zéro. Vous serez la première embauche en marketing de la division hôtelière et relèverez du VP Ventes et partenariats. Vous serez responsable des indicateurs qui transforment l'intérêt des hôtels en conversations de vente, notamment les MQL, les taux de conversion, la performance des séquences et la contribution au pipeline. Vous rédigerez aussi le contenu qui fait progresser ces chiffres.
 Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe des ventes, et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit et Succès client ainsi qu'avec nos partenaires externes en publicité au clic (PPC) et en référencement (SEO). Le mandat couvre HubSpot et les séquences de prospection sortante, jusqu'aux pages d'atterrissage, aux études de cas et aux campagnes.
 C'est vous qui déciderez quels canaux tester, quels contenus produire et ce qu'il faut abandonner. L'IA devrait faire partie de votre façon de travailler. Servez-vous-en pour faire de la recherche, rédiger, analyser et automatiser. La qualité du résultat reste votre responsabilité.
 Ce que nous valorisons
 L'aisance avec les chiffres, et la rigueur de les vérifier avant d'agir.
 Une écriture claire, précise et qui vaut la peine d'être lue.
 Prendre en charge les résultats et mener le travail à terme sans qu'on ait à faire de relances.
 Comprendre comment l'entreprise génère des revenus et se soucier des résultats.
 La curiosité, et la volonté d'abandonner une approche qui ne fonctionne pas.
 L'honnêteté de dire quand quelque chose n'est pas à la hauteur, y compris votre propre travail.
 Ce que vous ferez
 Bâtir et faire tourner le moteur de génération de la demande 
 Vous serez responsable de la génération de MQL pour la division hôtelière. Vous conviendrez avec l'équipe des ventes de ce qui constitue une piste qualifiée par le marketing, fixerez les cibles et ferez un suivi chaque semaine. Si le chiffre n'est pas atteint, vous saurez pourquoi avant qu'on vous le demande.
 L'essentiel de votre semaine sera consacré à l'exécution des programmes : séquences de prospection sortante et de maturation (nurturing) dans HubSpot, campagnes payantes avec notre partenaire PPC, référencement naturel avec notre partenaire SEO, courriels et pages d'atterrissage. Vous testerez plusieurs canaux en parallèle, comparerez le coût par MQL et le taux de conversion en opportunité, et concentrerez les efforts sur ce qui fonctionne.
 Rédiger le contenu qui convertit 
 Vous rédigerez vous-même les pages d'atterrissage, les séquences de courriels, les outils de vente, les articles de blogue, les témoignages clients, les études de cas et les annonces de produits. Chaque contenu a un rôle dans l'entonnoir, qu'il s'agisse de se classer sur un mot-clé, d'obtenir une démo ou d'aider l'équipe des ventes à conclure. Vous mesurerez s'il remplit ce rôle.
 Vous mènerez des entrevues avec des clients hôteliers et assisterez à des appels de vente, afin que le contenu reflète la façon dont les propriétaires, les directions générales et les responsables de la réception parlent des appels manqués, des réservations perdues et des ventes incitatives. Quand un contenu donne de moins bons résultats que prévu, vous le réécrirez ou le retirerez.
 Prendre en charge HubSpot et les opérations marketing 
 Vous serez responsable de HubSpot de bout en bout, y compris les flux de travail, la segmentation, la notation des pistes (lead scoring), l'acheminement vers l'équipe des ventes et les rapports. Vous établirez les règles de notation et de transfert des pistes avec le VP Ventes et partenariats, puis les ajusterez à mesure que vous découvrirez quels signaux annoncent une démo confirmée.
 Vous bâtirez la vue d'attribution qui montre quelles campagnes, quels canaux et quels contenus contribuent au pipeline, et vous maintiendrez des données assez propres pour qu'on puisse s'y fier. Si un tableau de bord affiche un résultat surprenant, vous creuserez la question avant d'en faire rapport.
 Ce que vous apportez
 Au moins 3 ans d'expérience pratique en génération de la demande B2B, en marketing de contenu ou en marketing de performance.
 Vous avez déjà été responsable d'une cible de MQL ou de pipeline, et vous pouvez nous présenter les chiffres derrière.
 Un portfolio de contenus que vous avez rédigés vous-même, comme des pages d'atterrissage, des séquences, des études de cas ou des articles, avec des résultats concrets à l'appui.
 Une expérience pratique de HubSpot ou d'une plateforme semblable, y compris les flux de travail, la notation des pistes et les rapports.
 Vous avez vous-même bâti et géré des séquences de prospection sortante ou de maturation.
 Vous savez créer un rapport, lire un entonnoir de conversion et repérer un chiffre erroné.
 De l'expérience dans la gestion de campagnes sur au moins trois canaux, comme le payant, le courriel, l'organique, la prospection sortante ou les événements.
 De l'expérience de travail avec des partenaires externes, comme des agences PPC ou SEO.
 Vous utilisez des outils d'IA pour accélérer la recherche, la rédaction, l'analyse et l'automatisation, et vous vérifiez ce qu'ils produisent.
 Vous savez travailler de façon autonome, transformer un objectif encore flou en plan et le mener à terme.
 Expérience utile
 Stratégie de contenu SEO
 Outils d’automatisation de la prospection et d’enrichissement de données
 Modèles d’attribution marketing
 Technologies hôtelières, hôtellerie ou voyage
 Produits SaaS B2B ou d’IA
 Compétences en vidéo ou en design pour la création publicitaire
 Marketing de salons professionnels et d’événements
 Mise sur pied d’une fonction marketing à partir de zéro
 Une formation en génie, en données ou dans un autre domaine technique
 Pourquoi vous aimerez travailler chez Sadie
 Vous vous joindrez à une entreprise d'IA en pleine croissance qui transforme le fonctionnement de l'hôtellerie et de la restauration.
 Votre travail façonnera directement notre stratégie de mise en marché auprès des hôtels.
 Beaucoup d'autonomie et de visibilité, tant dans la verticale hôtelière que dans la restauration.
 Des parcours de progression clairs : gestionnaire principal de contenu, gestionnaire de la génération de la demande ou opérations marketing.
 Un environnement hybride flexible et la possibilité d'assister aux grands événements de l'industrie.

 Founded by third-generation jeweller Noura Sakkijha, the brand was built on a simple idea: fine jewelry shouldn’t require a special occasion, and it should never come with guilt. It’s about celebrating yourself—your style, your life, your everyday.
 Mejuri meets customers where they are—online, in app, and through a growing global retail footprint of 58+ stores worldwide. Mejuri is also deeply committed to doing things the right way, with responsible sourcing, sustainable practices, and philanthropic initiatives that reflect our values and long-term vision.
 Overview
 (Financial Analyst- 12 month contract)
The Financial Analyst owns the numbers behind Mejuri's planning cycle: building the annual budget and the quarterly and monthly forecasts, then tracking actuals against them across departments, stores, and the consolidated business. Forecasts and budgets only matter if someone is watching how reality diverges from them — that ongoing read is what this role exists to provide.
 You'll prepare the reporting packages that give business leaders a clear view of their financials and headcount, with variance analysis that surfaces risk and opportunity before it shows up in results. You'll run the weekly cash flow report for the company, catch data issues at the source with Payroll, and work directly with business partners across departments who bring their numbers to you before they bring them to anyone else. 
 You'll join a small FP&A team, where one person's analysis often reaches a business leader directly, with no layer of review between the work and the decision it informs.
What You'll Do
 Planning & Forecasting 
 Budget and forecast accuracy — The annual budget and monthly and quarterly forecasts reflect where the business actually stands. You build them across departments and stores, then monitor results against plan and flag where they diverge.
 Cash flow reporting — The company gets an accurate weekly read on cash position. You assist in preparing this report on a consistent schedule, alongside ad hoc analysis as it comes up.
 Process improvement — Budgeting and forecasting get faster and more reliable over time. You look for where the current process breaks down and fix it, rather than working around it each cycle.
 Reporting & Business Partnering 
 Reporting packages — Business leaders see their financial results and headcount clearly, with the variance analysis to explain why. You prepare these packages and flag the risks and opportunities in them.
 Decision support — Business partners get an answer that changes what they decide, not just a summary of what happened. You analyze past and projected financial impact to support their calls.
 Fact-based challenge — Assumptions get tested before they become the forecast. You question inputs that don't hold up and push back with the numbers when they say something different.
 Systems fluency — Business partners get a better process, not just a report. You build a working knowledge of Mejuri's systems, processes, and financial statements, and use it to find where efficiency is possible.
 What You'll Bring
